dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Of course, that's exactly what I was thinking. I just happened to be wondering where to find you, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Nothing in particular, but friends should meet often, shouldn't they?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Unlike my colleagues, who operate from fixed locations, adventurers like you come and go like the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: See, if I want to visit Mr. Flins, all I need to do is visit the lighthouse during the day a few extra times, keep knocking, and I'll find him eventually.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: And if I want to contact Miss Nefer, even if I can't find her in person, I can leave a message at the Curatorium of Secrets to schedule a meeting.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: By comparison, finding you is much harder. After all, you're often out adventuring, and might not even be in Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll come by to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Haha, sounds like something I would say. Never thought I'd be on the receiving end.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Thanks! Still, would be better if I had a way to contact you anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Could we get Miss Aino to invent some kind of instant messaging device? To be honest, we Ratniki could really use something like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It might be faster to just post a commission.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Huh. I didn't think of that. It does have "adventurer" written all over it...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Right, wrote it down. You can look forward to receiving a commission to "guard a camp with the Ratniki."

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: As for the commission itself... you'll spend the whole day playing cards with my colleagues and me.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Though, I'm still not sure how good you are yet... Maybe we should have Mr. Flins join too...

choices.text: No need to be so serious about it.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Haha, games are all about winning, though! I can't help but get serious.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Yes, the match will be one for the record books.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Haha, then call them all! Anyone you consider a friend is welcome amongst us Lightkeepers.
